replacements.text: The panel's configuration now sets the effort and tools for each reviewer slot. Each reviewer receives the change as a diff file. A run that dies follows a fixed recovery sequence. The panel does not yet check that a run used its pinned effort.

The agent running a review round chose each reviewer's effort and tool access. It also avoided one model for whole-document reads, although no run record supported that choice. Review cost and coverage were unpredictable.

The panel's configuration pins effort and tools for every reviewer slot. Each round record copies those values from the slot's pin. Every reviewer receives the change as a diff file. A run that dies mid-reasoning retries one effort step lower, then on the other provider, then halts the round. The shared routing table still supplies the models.
